intent: Let the geofence work without committing the user's home coordinates, and detect workouts through channels an unrooted app can read.
scope: focus_owner/lib/workout_signal.dart - new: manual, guarded and combined sources
Non-goal: no Device Owner provisioning; the app still applies no policy
changes: Coordinates are pushed to app-private storage rather than committed. The asset stays redacted, and the provisioning script greps config_secrets.sh instead of sourcing it - that file holds other secrets and this script has no business evaluating them.
Private storage was chosen for its lifetime as much as its permissions: it does not survive an uninstall, so reinstalling forces re-provisioning rather than silently inheriting a stale home.

Every failure mode in HomeLocationStore.read returns null instead of throwing. Null flows into the enforcement layer as location-unknown, which already fails closed into enforcing - so a corrupt file cannot become an unlock, and cannot crash the service either.
The manual workout signal is time-boxed rather than a toggle: a workout mode left on by accident is indistinguishable from having no exception at all.

GuardedWorkoutSignal catches broadly and times out, because nothing about a workout probe failing should be able to stop enforcement running. CombinedWorkoutSignal can name the source that opened the exception, so the UI can explain an unlock rather than presenting it as magic.

HideTestReceiver deleted. It had served its purpose - proving setApplicationHidden persistence - and it applied policy from an exported receiver, which has no place in a build that will later hold device owner.

verification.evidence: Exits non-zero with "HOME_LAT is 'REDACTED_LAT', not a coordinate - fill in .../config_secrets.sh". The shipped placeholder cannot silently become a geofence anchor.

'Coordinates written to com.kuhy.focus_owner private storage' then 'OK coordinates provisioned (43 bytes)'. --check reports presence and size only, never the coordinates themselves, since its output lands in scrollback and transcripts.

verification.command: adb shell run-as ... ls -la; adb shell cat /data/data/.../home_location.json
verification.evidence: -rw------- after an explicit chmod 600 (the default umask had left it 666), and the shell user gets 'Permission denied'. The /data/local/tmp staging copy is gone.

verification.command: cd focus_owner && flutter analyze && flutter test
verification.evidence: 'No issues found!' and 67 tests passing, 24 new. Covers malformed JSON, a non-object document, missing and non-numeric coordinates (the shape a leaked placeholder would take), out-of-range values, window expiry, and probes that throw or hang.

verification.command: rebuild + reinstall + dumpsys package | grep -c HideTest + am start
verification.evidence: 0 references in the installed APK. App launches and stays alive with no FATAL entries. dumpsys device_policy still reports Device Owner Type: -1.

risks: push_home_location.sh depends on run-as, which only works against a debuggable build. A release APK will need a different channel for the coordinates.

The coordinates now exist on the device in plaintext inside app-private storage. That is the same exposure the rooted system already accepted for config_secrets.sh, but it is worth stating: root or a full device backup would reveal them.

GuardedWorkoutSignal catches Object deliberately. That is the right call inside an enforcement loop, but it means a genuinely broken Health Connect integration will look identical to 'no workout in progress' - it needs its own logging when that path is implemented.
workoutExemptPackages still hardcodes the youtube.com mapping, so a new unblock domain in config.sh will not map to a package by itself.
Untouched and still true: DO hiding in user 0 is unproven, and BOOT_COMPLETED does not fire until first unlock.
rollback: git revert. All the new files are additive and nothing outside focus_owner imports them.
On the device: adb shell run-as com.kuhy.focus_owner rm -f files/home_location.json removes the provisioned coordinates.
After rollback validate: flutter analyze && flutter test pass, and push_home_location.sh --check reports no coordinates provisioned.
